proposal.summary: IBM Financial Transaction Manager 3.2.0 through 3.2.7 could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system.
proposal.cwe_quote: could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system.

AV.quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

C.quote: to view arbitrary files on the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the vulnerability and apply necessary patches or mitigations.
